title: Prior art: Feynman harness as model for a standalone Pi wrapper
description: Idea (user, 2026-10-21): build a full Pi wrapper the way the Feynman harness does, so csnotes' Pi behavior, aesthetics (cf. #188), and plugin setup (cf. #187, #195 gate) stay independent of the user's main Pi installation, even if Pi becomes their daily driver. Next step: review the Feynman harness together AFTER the user's midterm for perspective on similar work, then decide whether this changes the PI-PLAN phases (#177/#178).
